svg.title: NVC-DelayFormer System Architecture
svg.desc: Physiology-guided temporal fusion for cross-subject EEG-fNIRS brain-computer interfaces with delay priors, causal masking, entropy gating, and online CrEA.

g.text: Capillary Transit Peak Delay: Δτ = t_i^nirs - t_j^eeg ∈ [3.5, 6.5] s
x_bio = [p_θ; p_α; p_β; x̄_n^delay; s_n] ∈ ℝ^[B × 234] (Spectral Log-Powers + Slopes)
Bottleneck Projection (234 → 32 → 64) → z_shallow ∈ ℝ^[B × 64] (Preserves Transient Phase)
Attentive Temporal Pyramid Pooling (TPP) & Feature Aggregation
Multi-Head Values U_h = A^(h) V^(h) Projected via W_o ∈ ℝ^(64×64) → H_f = LN(H_n + Drop(U W_o))

svg.text: Stage 3: Adaptive Gating, Online CrEA & Decoding

g.text: Prediction Entropies: H(p̂) = -∑ p̂_c ln p̂_c Evaluated from Detached Readouts
g_b = σ( F_g([z_deep,b; z_shallow,b; H(p̂_deep); H(p̂_shallow)]) ) ∈ (0, 1)^64
Fused Representation: z_fused = g_b ⊙ z_deep + (1 - g_b) ⊙ z_shallow
• Empirical Bayes Shrinkage Prior: κ_0 = 5.0 (Cold-Start Stabilization)
• Online Trial-by-Trial Streaming | Strict Zero Test-Set Information Leakage
Per-Trial Update Complexity: O(C^2) vs Offline O(N_trials · C^3)
Clinical Inference Latency: 2.22 ms | Model Parameters: 63,932 | Compute: 0.22 MACs
